Girder Glide.name: Girder Glide
Girder Glide.description: The user marks themselves with a pole and rides the pull toward steel: up a steel-framed building, along a rail or a girder, across a street to a lamppost or a bus. They can carry a passenger, and by pushing off the steel in the ground or the frame below they turn any fall into a soft landing. Strain: moderate.
